hooks.command: jq -r 'select(.tool_input.command | test("run-herald-benchmark")) | {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: "The HERALD benchmark just finished. You MUST now: (1) check what the highest-numbered file in docs/benchmark-notes/ is, (2) create the next sequential file (benchmark02.md, benchmark03.md, etc.) in that directory, (3) include a metadata header with the exact run timestamp and a summary of what changed/was calibrated since the previous benchmark run, (4) write a full assessment of the results covering overall metrics, per-claim-type breakdown, derivation method breakdown, tier distribution, diagnosis of gaps, and recommended next steps. Do this before responding to the user."}} | @json' 2>/dev/null || true
